665e717e30c80d15f6d16187deda62d38f2ac68f: Small-scale resort, Boí Taüll focuses on the quality of its welcome and its closeness rather than on impressive figures. Its 45 km of runs are ideal for a stay of 3 to 4 days, especially for families or skiers who don't need to constantly change their playground. The technical terrain is king at Boí Taüll: with 16 black runs and 15 red ones on offer, confirmed skiers will find plenty to really challenge themselves. Off-piste and freeride are often practised in excellent conditions thanks to the altitude and the aspect of the slopes. With a summit at 2751 m and a village at 2040 m, snow reliability at Boí Taüll is generally dependable from January to the end of March. A few exceptionally mild winters can cause tension early in the season, but things recover quickly once the first serious snowfalls arrive. The day lift pass at 50€ places Boí Taüll among the intermediate resorts on budget: neither cheap nor exorbitant. The quality of the ski area and its facilities justifies this price for most skiers. In short: Boí Taüll doesn't rival the giants of skiing, and doesn't pretend to. It's an honest destination, often underrated, that deserves to be (re)discovered.
